title: If Seedance doesn’t produce the expected motion from a simple prompt, add a…
content: If Seedance doesn’t produce the expected motion from a simple prompt, add a second prompt that explicitly specifies the camera movement/path (e.g., “fly over the waterfalls and the river”).
tips: If Seedance doesn’t produce the expected motion from a simple prompt, add a second prompt that explicitly specifies the camera movement/path (e.g., “fly over the waterfalls and the river”).

es.content: Si Seedance no produce el movimiento esperado a partir de un prompt simple, añade un segundo prompt que especifique explícitamente el movimiento o la trayectoria de la cámara (por ejemplo, “fly over the waterfalls and the river”).

fr.content: Si Seedance ne produit pas le mouvement attendu à partir d’un prompt simple, ajoutez un deuxième prompt qui précise explicitement le mouvement/le trajet de la caméra (par exemple : « fly over the waterfalls and the river »).

ja.content: Seedance がシンプルな prompt から期待どおりの motion を生成しない場合は、カメラの動きや軌道を明示的に指定する 2 つ目の prompt を追加してください（例: “fly over the waterfalls and the river”）。

ko.content: Seedance가 간단한 prompt로 기대한 motion을 만들어내지 못한다면, 카메라의 움직임/경로를 명시적으로 지정하는 두 번째 prompt를 추가하세요(예: “폭포와 강 위를 날아가라”).

pt.content: Se o Seedance não produzir o movimento esperado a partir de um prompt simples, adicione um segundo prompt que especifique explicitamente o movimento/caminho da câmera (por exemplo, “fly over the waterfalls and the river”).

zh.content: 如果 Seedance 没有从简单的 prompt 中生成预期的运动效果，可以再添加一个第二个 prompt，明确指定镜头运动/路径（例如：“fly over the waterfalls and the river”）。
